cohort: Women admitted to the postpartum ward who were more than 18 years old and had received the COVID-19 vaccine
finding: COVID-19 vaccination, regardless of the type of vaccine received before, during, or after pregnancy, is not associated with any unfavorable perinatal outcomes for pregnant women or neonates.
mod_finding: Mode of delivery was analyzed as a secondary outcome, but no specific findings related to mode of delivery are reported.
gest_age: Mean gestational age of unvaccinated women: 38.83 ± 1.62 weeks, vaccinated women: 37.69 ± 2.9 weeks
birth_weight: Average birth weight for unvaccinated women: 2.96 ± 0.4 kg, vaccinated women: 2.97 ± 0.66 kg
